full_prompt_en: A square contemporary oil painting shows a red-haired woman seated in a vivid orange-red dress against a loosely suggested café-like interior of cream, ocher, gray, and black. She occupies most of the center and right side, her crossed pale legs extending into the lower-left foreground. Her upper body turns toward the left, and her face looks beyond that edge with a calm, self-possessed expression. Loose dark crimson hair frames her face and falls in textured curls around the shoulders. The dress has a deep V neckline, fitted waist, and broad sleeves and skirt that break into angular scarlet, vermilion, and orange paint shapes. Its bright mass dominates the composition, while small dark strokes indicate seams and folds without meticulous stitching. Her left arm extends toward the lower-left area, where a short glass holding amber liquid catches warm highlights. Her other hand appears to brace against a dark seat or surface at the lower right. Behind her, upright blocks and scattered strokes suggest furniture, walls, and indistinct figures; none forms a fully resolved narrative detail. The left background has ocher vertical accents and pale gray panels, while the right side is darker and more crowded with deep blue-black marks. Light from the upper left and front brightens her face, bare skin, and the saturated dress, leaving the surrounding interior in broken middle tones and selective shadow. Thick, visible brush and palette-knife-like marks alternate with smoother handling around the facial features. The painted surface has scratches and overlaps that keep every color plane lively. No legible writing appears. The overall composition centers a fiery, sharply recognizable figure within a fragmented urban interior, balancing confident warm color against cool gray structure and dark accents.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形当代油画描绘一名红发女子坐在鲜艳橙红色长裙中，背景是由奶油色、赭色、灰色和黑色松散暗示的咖啡馆般室内。她占据中央和右侧大部分，交叠的浅色双腿伸向左下前景。上身转向左侧，面容望向画边以外，表情平静而自持。松散的深绯红头发框住面容，以有肌理的卷发落在肩旁。长裙有深V领口、收紧腰身和宽阔的袖子与裙摆，在棱角分明的猩红、朱红和橙色颜料形中展开。明亮色块主导构图，小的深色笔触指示缝线与衣褶，却不细描针脚。她左臂伸向左下方，一只盛琥珀色液体的矮玻璃杯在那里接住暖光。另一只手似乎撑在右下的深色座位或表面上。她身后，竖向色块和散落笔触暗示家具、墙面与不清楚的人影；没有哪一个构成充分明确的叙事细节。左背景有赭色竖向强调和浅灰平面，右侧则更暗，深蓝黑笔迹更密。来自左上与正面的光照亮面容、裸露肌肤和饱和长裙，周围室内留在破碎的中间调与局部阴影中。厚重可见的画笔和调色刀般的笔迹，与五官周围较平滑的处理交替。画面表面带刮痕和叠色，使每片色彩保持活跃。没有可读文字。整体构图把一个炽热、清楚易辨的形体置于破碎的城市室内，以自信暖色对照冷灰结构与深色强调。
style_prompt_en: The image has a contemporary oil-painted finish that combines recognizable focal modeling with broad angular impasto and scraped color blocks. Saturated vermilion, scarlet, and orange carry the central weight, offset by cream, cool gray, ocher, and deep blue-black. Focal details are smoothed enough to remain legible, while surrounding edges fracture into overlapping strokes and incomplete planes. Warm frontal light pulls bright surfaces forward; broken cool shadows and dark accents keep the background shallow and active. The composition concentrates one dominant color mass amid scattered vertical and horizontal fragments, with small reflective highlights as secondary beats. The overall effect is energetic, stylish, and tactile, with confident paint handling more important than seamless realism.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有当代油画完成面，把可辨识的焦点塑形与宽阔棱角厚涂和刮擦色块结合。饱和朱红、猩红和橙色承担中央重量，奶油色、冷灰、赭色与深蓝黑提供对照。焦点细节经过足够平滑的处理，保持清楚；周围边缘则碎裂成重叠笔触和未封闭平面。暖色正面光把明亮表面推向前景；破碎冷影与深色强调让背景浅而活跃。构图把一个主导色块放在散落的竖横碎片中，细小反光高光构成次级节拍。整体效果有活力、时髦而有触感，自信的颜料处理比无缝写实更重要。
theme_en: A red-haired woman in a vivid orange-red dress seated in a lively interior
theme_zh: 热闹室内身穿鲜橙红裙子的红发女子
name: Iryna Yermolova
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
